description: This file defines the LDAPAuthProvider class, which extends AbstractAuthProvider and implements LDAP authentication logic for the OrangeHRM system. It manages LDAP service interactions, user credential validation, and authentication flow control.

classes.name: LDAPAuthProvider
classes.description: A class responsible for authenticating users via LDAP in the OrangeHRM system, extending the abstract authentication provider to implement LDAP-specific logic.

methods.name: getLDAPService
methods.description: Returns an instance of LDAPService, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getLDAPSyncService
methods.description: Returns an instance of LDAPSyncService, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getAuthenticationService
methods.description: Returns an instance of AuthenticationService, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs LDAP authentication using provided credentials and user information.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority level of this authentication provider; used to determine its order in authentication attempts.
